method: Loaded prims 'l29' (16,912 items) and worked geometry first: listed all 105 INSERTs in the box by layer (all A-DOOR / A-DOOR-FRAM / A-GLAZ-CURT blocks; 9 top-level door blocks plus 1 nested double glass door in the 2501_ARCH_KPF link = 10 doors), dumped each door block's leaf / arc / frame lines and the extents of every 'System Panel - GLAZED' block, listed the 69 A-WALL / A-WALL-PATT / S-COLS hatch polygons in the box and checked every wall end for a facing end or perpendicular wall, listed all 73 arcs longer than 0.4 m (door swings vs furniture), inspected A-FLOR / A-AREA / A-DETL lines (thresholds, slab edge), and fitted the facade lines. Then rendered the part (east_full.png, --grid 1 --inserts) and 24 zoomed tiles at --grid 0.5 --inserts --px 2000 (rows y -35.5..-29.5, -40.5..-35, -45.5..-40, -50.5..-45, -55.5..-50, -61..-55 by columns x 10.5-16, 15.5-21, 20.5-26, 25.5-31; tiles r6c3 and r6c4 hold no entities, confirmed numerically), NE and SE facade corner close-ups, QA close-ups with end markers for L29E-03, 04, 05, 06, and finally the whole part with a marker on each of the 10 openings (east_marked.png): every door swing, leaf, sliding track and wall gap has a marker; nothing is left. Extents: doors in glass = leaf / frame extents between the adjoining glass panel ends; doors in solid walls (lift, sliding, double swing) = wall end to wall end on the wall centre line, frames included. Ids run north to south, then west to east.
